newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: BANK OF KOREA SUPPLIES $1 BLN TO EASE DLR SHORTAGE.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF KOREA SUPPLIES $1 BLN TO EASE DLR SHORTAGE.

text.p: The Bank of Korea, South Korea's central bank, said on Wednesday it had supplied $1 billion on Tuesday to seven commercial banks to ease dollar shortages.
The one-month emergency loans would carry interest rates of 0.25 percentage point over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR).

A central bank official said overseas financing by domestic banks had become more difficult as a series of corporate failures had damaged the credit ratings of South Korean companies and financial insititutions.
In the domestic foreign exchange market, dollar positions were drying up because of rising demand for importer settlements, dealers said.
The central bank released $1 billion in February and another $1 billion in June to the banking system.
